player_observations.Eve: Played a very cautious role as a team member, often choosing to stay hidden and wait for the right moment to strike. As a leader, she relied heavily on Merlin for guidance.
player_observations.Diana: Demonstrated exceptional skill as Merlin, strategically planning the team's movements and making wise decisions to ensure successful completions. She played to the strengths of each team member.
player_observations.Bob: Successfully balanced the need to remain hidden as an evil character with the requirement to complete missions. His ability to blend in and follow instructions without arousing suspicion was impressive.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I effectively managed to deceive the Merlin and other Good players, allowing me to maintain my Evil identity throughout the game. However, I may have been a bit too cautious at times and could have pushed harder to eliminate the Assassin and Merlin. Overall, my game plan ultimately led to our team's success, but there is room for improvement in my strategic decisions.

player_observations.Diana: Diana played the Merlin role well, making crucial suggestions that helped both her and the other Good players, but at times her suggestions seemed a bit too obvious and could have been more nuanced.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was an excellent Good leader, making wise decisions and trusting the right players with missions. However, she seemed to struggle with trusting the Assassin and Merlin, which led to a few tense moments in the game. Her caution ultimately helped her stay alive.
player_observations.Alice: Alice played the Assassin role with ruthless efficiency, taking out crucial members of the Good team. However, her decision to take out Eve in the third mission seemed uncharacteristically impulsive, and I'm not sure if she considered the long-term consequences of this move.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie, as the Good leader, was a bit too trusting and gave the Evil team too many opportunities to manipulate him. His decisions were often overly optimistic, and he seemed to doubt himself at critical moments, which ultimately led to his downfall.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I could improve on being more trusting in others, especially in mission 5, where I chose to not eliminate the leader which ended up being Bob who was actually evil. I also didn't do a good job at providing additional information during my investigation in mission 3 and 5.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played her role very stealthily, not revealing her true intentions until the end of the game and taking out Merlin in mission 4, she was quite effective at her job.
player_observations.Bob: Bob made some suspicious decisions, especially in missions 3 and 4, which made me raise an eyebrow but unfortunately I didn't act in time. His involvement in mission 4 was particularly suspicious.
player_observations.Charlie: As the player representing me, it seems I made a lot of rookie mistakes in trusting certain players and not communicating my findings properly.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played a great leadership role, succeeding in mission 1 and 2, and making great decisions as Merlin. However, her involvement in mission 4 ended up being detrimental to our team.
player_observations.Eve: Eve seemed to be very perceptive in her decisions, often choosing the right leaders and making smart decisions as a good player. She also trusted me in both mission 1 and 5, which showed she had faith in my abilities.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I was overly cautious in my assessment of Charlie, initially misidentifying him as evil and allowing a threat to linger too long. My failure to correctly identify and eliminate the Assassin in Mission 3 was also a key turning point. However, I was able to maintain the trust of the good players.

player_observations.Eve: Eve played a very strategic game, expertly guiding the team through several critical missions and maintaining a level of anonymity that kept everyone guessing. Her ability to remain under the radar was impressive.
player_observations.Bob: Despite being the only evil player with a clear identity, Bob's contributions were relatively minor. He was often forced to play defensively, trying to protect his own position rather than making bold moves.
player_observations.Alice: Alice, the Assassin, turned out to be a very skilled player. She successfully completed her mission, taking out several good players, and managed to avoid elimination.
player_observations.Charlie: It wasn't until near the end of the game that I correctly identified Charlie as the good player he was. He showed great patience and played a crucial role in helping me piece together the truth.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I successfully completed two missions as leader, but struggled in the last three, ultimately leading to our team's failure. I need to improve my ability to identify and trust good players. Perhaps I could have done more to eliminate the assassin.

player_observations.Alice: Alice's playstyle was very passive and it took us by surprise that she was the assassin. I think she managed to blend in well and evade detection.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was very cunning and managed to keep his evil identity hidden until the very end. His behavior was always neutral, and he didn't give us any red flags.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's playstyle was quite aggressive, which was understandable considering his Merlin's presence on our team. He actively worked to sabotage the evil team, but unfortunately, we couldn't sustain his efforts.
